sources.entry: thealgorithms - All algorithms implemented in Python.

summary.one_liner: A educational collection of algorithms implemented in Python, listed under "Algorithms and Design Patterns" in the awesome-python list.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes the repository as a collection of all algorithms implemented in Python, intended for education. It states that the implementations are for learning purposes and may be less efficient than the Python standard library equivalents. Contributors are pointed to a Contribution Guidelines document. The README links to a Discord community for questions and help. The algorithm list itself is not in the README; it refers readers to a directory for navigation. The README alone does not specify which algorithm categories are covered.
use_cases: studying reference implementations of classic algorithms
contributing algorithm implementations to an open-source project
notable: Educational focus: implementations are written for learning rather than production performance
Organized through a project directory for navigating the algorithms
Community Discord for questions and help
Contribution guidelines provided for new contributors
caveats: Implementations may be less efficient than Python standard library equivalents, per the README
The README does not list the individual algorithms; navigation depends on the external directory
License not stated in the README
keywords: how to learn algorithms in python
